t: Air variant of Aldona E for three months I suffer
d: On the left side of a castle, the ruined walls overlooking a large area of the village. On the right, there is a stairway to the castle. It is near the night. Albano, Donne, Famigli e Vecchi Lithuaniani.
Piazza della cathedral of Marienburgo. Houses are party parades. People who break into the square festive: then Vitoldo and Dukes. Albano, side by side observing.

Grand hall in the castle of Marienburg. Corrado is seated at the canteen among the Teuton Knights, Vitoldo, German Duci. On the front the Trovatori, Menestrelli, Schiara Moorish and Saracen, Paggi with amphorae of wine. Albano is wandering around exploring.

The ruins of a cloister. At the end of the scene, headlands and valleys covered with snow. On the front the split of an oratory. A pedestal surmounted by a cross. It is the sunset. At the rise of the curtain, you will see Soldiers fleeing, and others who supported by their companions slowly descend from the yokes. On the front of the scene, Women and Children praying on their knees at the foot of the cross.
Room of the castle of Marienburg. Corrado and Albano.
Expressly written for Mrs. Maddalena Mariani-Masi.
